'''Trech Molock''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] who served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Having reached the rank of [[High General]], he acted as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Army Operations]] [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] under [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]]. While his direct superior was rather circumspect, Molock was not reluctant to take major risks. Because of that, he often engaged in heated, yet private debates with Tagge. He was present in the Death Star's [[Death Star conference room/Legends|meeting room]] when [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Oversector Outer]], announced the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|disbanding]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].

==Biography==
[[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] to [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Parent/Legends|parents]], Trech Molock hailed from [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Some point after [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] enlisted in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|armed forces]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Molock worked his way up the military career ladder,<ref name="SWI" /> attaining the rank of [[High General]].<ref name="DSOTM">''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]''</ref> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he had been assigned to serve as the [[Army Operations]] [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. As such, he was directly accountable to his fellow High General [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]], Head of the Army Operations. The two men would often disagree on matters of military doctrine, with Molock judging his superior too conservative.<ref name="SWI" />

[[File:ImperialsConferencing-ANH.png|thumb|left|Molock attending a meeting aboard the Death Star]]
On the third [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine issued the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], the last vestige of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|democratic government]] that had preceded the Empire. Along with other [[Officer/Legends|officers]], Molock was attending a meeting in the the Death Star's [[Death Star conference room/Legends|conference room]] when [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] of the [[Oversector Outer]] relayed the information. Not too long afterward, the Death Star was destroyed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="anh" />

==Personality and traits==
A male Human, Molock had fair skin and wore mid-length, [[Color/Legends|reddish-brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that fell over his neck in the back.<ref name="anh" /> He had a risk-taking type of personality and did not hesitate to confront his superior in stormy discussions, although only in private.<ref name="SWI" />

==Equipment==
While on duty, the general wore a light gray version of the issued [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|Imperial military uniform]], a double-breasted tunic<ref name="anh" /> with matching pants and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> On the left side of his [[Breast/Legends|chest]], he wore a six-squared [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|insignia plaque]] as a symbol of his rank.<ref name="anh" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although he appeared in the [[1977]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="anh" /> Molock was only identified as such in [[2013]] in [[A Certain Point of View (department)|''The Death Star Coup'']], an article written by [[Jason Fry]] for the [[Star Wars Insider Special Edition 2014|Special Edition 2014]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine. The article, however, does not precise whether Molock died in the destruction of the Death Star over [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] or not.<ref name="SWI" />

He shares his surname<ref name="SWI" /> with [[Sate Pestage|Sate Molock]], an unused character from early drafts of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] who ultimately became the [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]].<ref name="SWAS">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref> The character's given name was inspired by [[Chris Trevas]]'s "Star Wars name" according to an Internet meme, which requires taking the first three letters of one's last name and the first two letters one's first name.<ref name="Trech's name">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsSourcebooks|url=StarWarsSourcebooks/posts/634665586583552|name=Chris Trevas|date=30-10-2013|quote=Lucasfilm allowed us come up with Molock's first name.|archivefile=File:TrechMolock-Facebook.png}}</ref> According to the fan website [http://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman], Molock was portrayed by [[Charlie Gray]],<ref name="Aveleyman">{{WebCite|url=http://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=103471|text=Aveleyman - Charlie Gray|archivedate=20190307182858}}</ref> an actor listed as one of the Imperial Bureaucrats in [[Ann Skinner]]'s continuity notes.<ref name="ImperialGathering2">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2016/10/behind-scenes-imperial-gathering.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=BEHIND THE SCENES: IMPERIAL GATHERING!}}</ref>
